column1: # Custom partition table for ESP32 4 MB flash with OTA support.
# Two equal OTA slots of ~1.9 MB each.  The factory app slot is omitted so
# both slots are available for OTA.  After the initial USB flash
# updates can be delivered wirelessly via the OTA HTTP server.
#   0x00d000  otadata      8 KB   (bookkeeping for active OTA slot)
#   0x3f0000  (end — 64 KB unused at top of 4 MB)
